name: BillBuddy - Bills & Budget
short_description: Track bills, manage budgets, split expenses & understand spending.
description:
BillBuddy: Bills & Budget

Stay on top of bills, manage your budget, understand your spending, and keep shared money organized — all in one place.

No spreadsheets. No scattered reminders. Just a clearer way to see what you owe, what's coming next, and where your money is going.

🧾 YOUR BILLS, ORGANIZED

Keep every important payment in one place.

Track rent, EMI payments, credit cards, electricity, water, gas, internet, mobile bills, insurance, loans, subscriptions and other recurring expenses.

• Add bills with amount, category and due date
• Track upcoming, paid and overdue bills
• Set payment reminders
• Create recurring bills
• Record payment methods and payment history

📅 NEVER LOSE TRACK OF DUE DATES

Use the calendar to see your payment schedule at a glance.

• View upcoming payments
• Find overdue bills
• Check bills by date
• Add bills from the calendar
• Keep your monthly payment schedule organized

Know what needs your attention before the due date arrives.

💰 MANAGE YOUR MONTHLY BUDGET

Keep an eye on your monthly spending with a simple budget overview.

See your bills, spending and remaining budget in one place, helping you stay aware of your finances throughout the month.

📊 UNDERSTAND YOUR SPENDING

Go beyond bill reminders with useful spending insights.

Explore:

• Spending trends
• Category breakdowns
• Monthly summaries
• Payment history
• Interactive charts

See where your money goes and understand how your spending changes over time.

🔄 KEEP RECURRING PAYMENTS ORGANIZED

Rent. EMIs. Insurance. Utilities. Subscriptions.

Create recurring bills and keep their schedules organized so you always know when the next payment is coming.

🤝 SPLIT SHARED EXPENSES

Sharing expenses shouldn't require spreadsheets or scattered messages.

Track shared bills with friends, family or roommates, monitor outstanding amounts and keep settlements organized.

💸 BORROW & LEND

Keep track of money you've borrowed or lent.

• See money you've lent
• See money you've borrowed
• Track outstanding balances
• Add due dates and payment details

Keep personal lending and borrowing records organized in one place.

➕ ADD BILLS YOUR WAY

Add bills using the available entry, scanning and import options in BillBuddy.

Save the important details and keep your payments organized from one place.

🌍 MULTI-CURRENCY SUPPORT

Manage bills and expenses using multiple currencies, including INR, USD, EUR and GBP.

Choose your preferred currency and personalize your financial experience.

📄 EXPORT, IMPORT & REPORTS

Keep your financial records accessible.

• Export bill data as CSV
• Import existing bill data
• Generate PDF reports
• Organize reports by payment status

🔐 PERSONALIZE YOUR EXPERIENCE

BillBuddy supports:

• Google and Email sign-in
• Currency preferences
• Language preferences
• Profile settings
• Dark Mode and Light Mode
• Multi-language support

EVERYTHING FOR EVERYDAY MONEY

Bills — Know what needs to be paid.
Budget — Keep track of your monthly spending.
Insights — Understand where your money goes.
Calendar — See your payment schedule.
Splits — Organize shared expenses.
Borrow & Lend — Track money between you and others.
Reports — Keep your financial records accessible.

KNOW WHAT YOU OWE. KNOW WHERE YOUR MONEY GOES.

BillBuddy makes everyday money management simpler.

Track your bills. Manage your budget. Understand your spending. Stay organized.
features: Unified tracking of EMIs, bills, and subscriptions
Visual calendar interface for due dates

name: Aarti Sangrah: Daily Prayers
short_description: 300+ Aartis, Mantras, Chalisas & custom pooja playlists for your daily worship.
description:
Aarti Sangrah is a comprehensive Hindu devotional app designed to bring over 300 sacred prayers, Aartis, Chalisas, Mantras, and Stotrams directly to your smartphone. Whether performing morning puja, observing festival fasts, or seeking spiritual peace, Aarti Sangrah helps you organize and read sacred scriptures effortlessly in a clean, distraction-free environment.

Organize your devotional routine with custom Pooja Playlists. Create personalized sequences for Ganesh Chaturthi, Navratri, Diwali, or daily morning prayers. Arrange your Aartis in exact worship order, reorder them with drag-and-drop ease, and share your playlists with family and friends via direct web and app links.

Key Features of Aarti Sangrah:

• 300+ Sacred Devotional Texts: Access a vast collection of Aartis, Ashtakams, Mantras, Chalisas, Stotrams, Bhajans, Kathas, and Shlokas.

• Custom Pooja Playlists: Create, edit, and reorder prayer lists for festivals and daily worship routines. Sequence your prayers step-by-step.

• Multi-Language Support: Read devotional text seamlessly in 13 Indian languages, including English, Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Bengali, Assamese, Kannada, Malayalam, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, and Urdu.

• Categorized by Deity & Festival: Easily browse prayers dedicated to Lord Ganesha, Lord Krishna, Lord Shiva, Goddess Durga, Lord Rama, Hanuman Ji, Goddess Laxmi, and Surya Dev. Filter by major occasions such as Diwali, Navratri, Ganesh Chaturthi, Janmashtami, and Maha Shivratri.

• Customizable Reading Experience: Adjust font sizes (14pt to 32pt) for comfortable reading during rituals. Navigate smoothly between prayers with simple swipes.

• Smart Search & Instant Filters: Quickly search by prayer title, deity name, festival, or language with real-time suggestions and search history.

• Audio Aarti Support: Listen to selected audio Aartis directly within the app for a complete prayer experience.

• Offline Reading & Sync: Access cached prayers offline during worship. Sign in with Google to save and sync your favorite Aartis across devices.

Aarti Sangrah eliminates the need to carry physical prayer books or browse multiple websites during puja. Designed with clear typography, warm devotional aesthetics, and intuitive controls, Aarti Sangrah makes everyday worship simple, meaningful, and accessible.

Download Aarti Sangrah today to bring sacred prayers and personalized worship routines to your daily life.
features: Adjustable font sizing and reading modes

name: Ghost Trap: Reveal the World
short_description: Claim territory, dodge or trap ghosts, reveal world landmarks in arcade puzzle!
description:
🎮 Claim territory, outsmart ghosts, and reveal stunning world landmarks in Ghost Trap – a tactical arcade puzzle game that challenges your spatial strategy and quick thinking.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎯 HOW TO PLAY

Navigate Champ across the grid, carving paths to claim territory while avoiding bouncing ghosts. Claim 80%+ of each level to reveal breathtaking images of famous landmarks from around the world.

Each completed level brings you closer to mastering entire countries – from the Taj Mahal in India to Mount Fuji in Japan.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⚡ CORE GAMEPLAY

🗺️ Territory Claiming
Draw paths from safe zones into unclaimed territory. Connect back to safety to claim the enclosed area. But watch out – if a ghost touches your path before you finish, you lose a life!

💪 Strategic Power-Ups
• 🚀 Speeder – Move twice as fast for 30 seconds
• 🥶 Frost – Slow down ghosts by 50% for 30 seconds
• 🧊 Freeze – Stop all ghosts completely for 60 seconds

📈 Progressive Challenge
30 levels per stage with increasing difficulty. Early levels ease you in with 3 slow ghosts, while later levels challenge you with 8 fast-moving enemies.

🌍 World Exploration
Journey across countries and continents. Each stage represents a different nation with 30 unique landmarks to discover. Complete all levels to unlock the next country and earn bonus rewards.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✨ KEY FEATURES

❤️ Fair Lives System
Start with 5 lives. Lives regenerate automatically – 1 life every 30 minutes. No pressure, no forced waiting. Play at your own pace.

🎁 Generous Rewards
Earn coins, power-ups, and infinity lives passes by completing levels. Collect rewards in your Reward Box and claim them whenever you want.

📴 Offline Play
Play anywhere, anytime – no internet required. Your progress syncs automatically when you reconnect.

☁️ Cloud Save
Link your Google account to back up your progress and play across multiple devices. Never lose your achievements.

💎 Optional Purchases
Remove ads permanently, buy coin packs, or unlock infinity lives passes. All purchases are optional – enjoy the full game for free.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎮 GAME CONTENT

✓ Multiple stages representing countries worldwide
✓ 30 levels per stage featuring famous landmarks
✓ Progressive difficulty that rewards skill improvement
✓ Reward Box system for claiming earned bonuses
✓ In-game store with optional purchases
✓ Settings and customization including sound controls

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💯 WHY PLAYERS LOVE GHOST TRAP

🧠 Pure Logic Gameplay
No random chance. No pay-to-win mechanics. Success depends entirely on your spatial strategy and timing.

🏛️ Beautiful Landmark Reveals
Each level completion unveils a stunning high-definition image of a world-famous place. It's part puzzle, part discovery.

⏱️ Smooth Progression
Fair life regeneration means you're never stuck waiting. Watch rewarded ads to earn extra lives, coins, or power-ups if you want to keep playing.

✨ Polished Experience
Clean dark theme interface with neon accents. Intuitive touch controls. Satisfying confetti celebrations when you win.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

👥 PERFECT FOR

✓ Fans of classic arcade games like Xonix, Qix, and Jezzball
✓ Puzzle enthusiasts who enjoy spatial strategy
✓ Players who want fair free-to-play games
✓ Anyone who loves discovering world landmarks
✓ Casual gamers looking for quick sessions
✓ Hardcore players seeking challenging levels

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🌟 DOWNLOAD NOW

Start your journey in India with the iconic Taj Mahal, then unlock stages across Japan, France, USA, Australia, and beyond.

Can you master every landmark and conquer the world? 🌍

name: Zip Connect: Number Puzzle
short_description: Connect numbers, fill every cell and solve relaxing logic puzzles.
description:
Connect numbers, fill every cell and solve relaxing logic puzzles.

Zip Connect is a number puzzle game where you connect numbers in order and complete the entire grid with one continuous path. Start with simple puzzles and use logic, planning and careful moves to solve increasingly challenging levels.

HOW TO PLAY

Start at number 1 and connect the numbers in sequence.

• Connect numbers in the correct order
• Move horizontally or vertically
• Don't skip numbers
• Don't cross your path
• Fill every cell of the grid
• Complete the path to solve the puzzle

EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO MASTER

The rules are simple, but solving every grid requires careful planning. Find the right path, avoid dead ends and think ahead before making your next move.

PROGRESS THROUGH PUZZLES

Begin with easier number puzzles and gradually take on more challenging grids. Every completed level helps you improve your logic and problem-solving skills.

USE HINTS WHEN YOU'RE STUCK

Can't find the next move? Use a hint to get guidance and continue solving difficult puzzles.

EARN XP AND REWARDS

Complete puzzles and earn XP as you progress. Keep solving levels, improve your rank and challenge yourself to go further.

RELAXING PUZZLE EXPERIENCE

Zip Connect is designed for players who enjoy calm, focused gameplay. Solve a quick puzzle during a break or spend longer sessions working through challenging levels.

PLAY OFFLINE

Enjoy your puzzles wherever you are. Gameplay is available offline, so you can keep solving without an internet connection.

WHY PLAY ZIP CONNECT?

• Number and logic puzzles
• Connect numbers in sequence
• Grid-based path puzzles
• Increasing difficulty
• Helpful hint system
• XP and progression
• Relaxing gameplay
• Offline puzzle gameplay
• Suitable for quick sessions or longer challenges

If you enjoy number puzzles, logic games, brain puzzles and grid challenges, Zip Connect gives you a simple rule with increasingly challenging paths to solve.
features: Minimalist visual design with smooth transitions
Quick level reset and help options

Start with simple puzzles and gradually take on larger, more challenging boards. Every puzzle is easy to understand, but finding the perfect path becomes increasingly satisfying.

A SIMPLE PUZZLE WITH DEPTH

The rules are simple: connect the nodes in order and complete the entire grid.

But as the puzzles become harder, you'll need to think ahead, plan your route, and make every move count.

Whether you enjoy number puzzles, logic games, brain teasers, or relaxing offline games, Zip Connect gives you a simple puzzle experience that becomes more challenging as you progress.

Play a few quick puzzles when you have a moment, or work your way through increasingly difficult challenges.

Use hints when needed, improve your solving skills, and try to complete puzzles more efficiently.

Zip Connect is designed to be easy to learn, satisfying to solve, and challenging enough to keep you coming back.
